messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: AUTOPAGE triggered - PagerDuty PD-47-9012 -> host gpu-node-17.prod.r3 (rack r3u7). Trigger: kubelet NotReady + kernel oops during driver init. Evac and autoscale kickstarted. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-47-9012

PagerDuty: AUTO PAGE: PD-47-9012 assigned to nora@redwood, infra rotation. Priority: P1 (auto-escalate 4m).

Nora: Ack. Jumping in. Quick status: any customer errors surfacing?

Emma (support): We have two customer tickets in EU showing 502s since ~2026-03-22T03:45Z, and one internal alert for elevated retry rates.

Sam: Pulling kube events and system logs. Short excerpt from serial: 
```
Mar 22 03:44:55 kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:5a:00): 79, GPU fell off bus
Mar 22 03:44:55 kernel: kernel: BUG: soft lockup - CPU#2 stuck for 23s
Mar 22 03:45:02 kubelet: NodeStatus: NotReady
```
Looks like driver init failing repeatedly.

Theo: If kubelet is NotReady, pods may be being evicted. Are there any pinned or hostNetwork pods?

Sam: Two pinned replicas for dedicated-tenant-7 live on that host (statefulset with nodeAffinity). Controller manager attempted failover but affinity blocked quick scheduling -> transient 503s.

Infra SRE: Starting cordon+drain. Commands run: 
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-17.prod.r3
kubectl drain gpu-node-17.prod.r3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30s --force
```
Drain progress: 8 normal pods evicted, 3 pods pending recreated, 1 stuck in Terminating (kubelet unreachable).

IncidentBot: Escalating - if no ack from next rotation will page infra-lead.

Nora: Initiating BMC power-cycle. Serial console attached. If reboot doesn't clear, we'll set node to quarantined.

Infra SRE: BMC cycle issued (ipmitool chassis power cycle). Serial shows same oops during driver load. Reboot loop.

Theo: Could be PCIe link issue. Check dmesg for AER/uncorrectable errors and pcieport resets.

Sam: Found repeated AER messages: 
```
pcieport 0000:00:1e.0: AER: Uncorrected (Non-Fatal) error received: id=0004
PCIe Bus Error: severity=Uncorrected (Non-Fatal), type=Transaction Layer, id=00e0
```
Suggest RMA.

Infra SRE: Marking node out_of_rotation and opening RMA ticket RMA-7012. Provisioning replacement node in same rack to preserve NIC bandwidth allocations.

Emma (support): Customer comms: posted "partial degradation" alert to status page, listed affected regions and workarounds (retries/backoff). Customers have been notified of mitigation and ETA for stable replacements.

Nora: Action items: 1) disable nodeAffinity pins for impacted statefulsets (ops-approved) to allow replicas to reschedule, 2) confirm no other nodes in rack exhibiting AER, 3) ensure KV cache warmup for the two heavy models.

Theo: I'll sweep rack for AER noise. So far only gpu-node-17 shows AERs. Running continuous PCIe stress tests on replacement prior to join.

Sam: Replacement node provisioned and joined cluster at 03:55Z. Controller created replacement pods; rebalancing completed. Observed brief p99 spike: 380ms -> 1.1s during rewarm window.

Emma (support): Tickets updated with mitigation notes. No enterprise customers have escalated for SLA credits at this time. Monitoring shows error rates back to baseline after 12 minutes.

Nora: Handing over to next oncall in 20m. Summary: gpu-node-17 experienced kernel oops and AER leading to kubelet NotReady; automated drain moved pods; pinned replicas caused short customer impact; node quarantined and RMA opened; replacement provisioned and traffic stabilized. Severity: Sev2.

IncidentBot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: PD-47-9012 -> status: resolved. Resolution: failover completed, node quarantined, replacement active. Duration: 00:10:73.

Nora: I'll file a quick follow-up: check default affinity policies for stateful workloads and recommend a safety knob to allow temporary overrides during auto-evac. :white_check_mark:
